description: ballRaise 20 alone turns the toe pivot 20, the same as a roll of 20 in the ball regime: y = 3.3 + 0.7 cos20 + 1.8 sin20, z = 1.8 + 0.7 sin20 - 1.8 cos20. The toe pivot is the toe joint (4, 3.3, 1.8), so the hand at (4, 4, 0) is offset (dy 0.7, dz -1.8) from it, the toe bone's length 1.931321, and it keeps that length to the planted toe. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target.
